description: Digoxin in heart failure with amiodarone: the heart-failure switch uses the 20 mL/min non-renal component and the measured P-gp interaction halves clearance, so the dose falls from 125 to 62.5 ug daily
citation: Koup JR et al. Clin Pharmacol Ther 1975;18:9-21; Moysey JO et al. Br Med J 1981;282:272; 2021 ESC heart failure guidelines
